resetDialog.title: Reset settings?
resetDialog.message: Language, theme, provider, models and advanced options will be reset to defaults. API keys and storage settings are kept.

general.modelsNote: Vision models released in the last {{count}} months. Lists refresh monthly.
general.modelsNoteAll: All vision models. Lists refresh monthly.
general.modelsPreview: Preview from the public models.dev directory. Enter an API key to choose a model.
general.modelsEmpty: No models available. Check the key or server and refresh the list.
general.serverHint: Local OpenAI-compatible LM Studio server, e.g. 192.168.1.14 — http:// and port 1234 are added automatically.

fit.balanced: Good for tags: fast and inexpensive, reads printed text reliably.
fit.precise: For difficult tags — rusty, crumpled, shot at an angle or with glare: more accurate, but slower and pricier.
fit.economy: Fastest and cheapest: enough for clean, well-shot tags, makes more mistakes on difficult ones.
fit.local: Runs inside the plant network, photos never leave it. Accuracy depends on model size and quantization.

storage.intro: Tags sent with “Next” are appended as rows to the .xlsx table — on the network share or in Google Drive: one at a time, in the background, with a check after each save.

smb.filePathHint: Path inside the shared folder, ending with .xlsx. Missing folders and the table itself are created on the first upload.
smb.testOkExisting: The table was found: {{size}} KB, last modified {{date}}.
smb.testOkNew: The table does not exist yet and will be created on the first upload.

googleDrive.signOutMessage: The app’s access to Google Drive of {{account}} will be revoked. Queued uploads will wait for a new sign-in.
googleDrive.locationHint: Folder link from the Drive address bar or its ID; empty — the root of My Drive. The table and a “backups” folder appear there on the first upload.

storage.backups: Before every save a backup is created in the “backups” folder next to the table; backups older than {{days}} days are deleted.

advanced.promptHint: Instructions for the model. A JSON template with the selected fields is appended automatically.
advanced.fieldsHint: The model reads only the checked fields from the photo.
advanced.fieldsEditHint: Tap a field to rename it in each language or describe it for the model. English is required for your own fields.
advanced.fieldDeleteMessage: “{{name}}” will no longer be read from photos.
advanced.fieldsResetMessage: Your own fields will be deleted, the built-in ones get their default names, and the five main ones are enabled: producer, steel grade, size, heat number and weight.
advanced.fieldHintPlaceholder: What this field is and how it is labelled on tags (in English is best), e.g. “Lot number, printed as Lot: 1”
advanced.imageSizeHint: Smaller photos upload faster and cost less. Tag text stays readable from 1600 px.
advanced.imageSizeAnthropic: Claude (Anthropic) accepts photos up to 5 MB. With “Original” a camera shot may be rejected — keep 2048 px or less for Claude.
